 Spotlight
 

Safety before streaming

What’s happening? The UAE governemnt have been issuing mobile alerts through the National Early Warning System to keep residents and visitors' informed about the ongoing Israel-US and Iran tensions. The geo-targeted notifications, sent directly to phones, provide real-time safety instructions, including when to seek shelter. Agencies including the National Emergency Crisis and Disaster Management Authority (NCEMA) and the Ministry of Interior say the system is designed to deliver urgent guidance swiftly and ensure public safety.

No filming: Authorities warn against prioritising social media filming over safety during emergency alerts, with violators facing legal accountability. The Ministry of Interior (MoI) reported residents stopping vehicles or leaving homes to record videos post-notification. Authorities emphasised that alerts are issued solely to protect the public, instructing immediate sheltering indoors or in secure locations until an "all clear" signal. Drivers must continue to destinations without roadside stops.

Emergency hotline: The MoI reminded residents that the national emergency hotline 999 is reserved strictly for genuine emergencies. Residents are urged to avoid spreading unverified information online, keep phone lines free for critical cases, and follow updates from official sources to support the country’s coordinated emergency response.

Career
 

AI Engineer / Automation Engineer

Remote Full-time AED 4,000 - 5,999/month

Adamantium AI, a Dubai-based AI consultancy specializing in intelligent automation and AI-powered workflows, is looking for an AI Engineer / Automation Engineer. The role focuses on designing and deploying practical AI systems for client businesses, including chatbots, workflow automation, sales automation tools, and AI integrations with CRMs and marketing platforms. Candidates should have experience with Python or JavaScript, API integrations, prompt engineering, and automation tools such as Zapier, Make, or n8n. Experience with LangChain, RAG systems, vector databases, or production AI deployments is a plus.

Meanwhile
 

Consular services halted

The US Embassy in Abu Dhabi and the US Consulate General in Dubai are closed, and services cannot be provided in those facilities until further notice. Major attractions like Dubai Parks and Resorts, Global Village, and Ain Dubai remain closed due to regional security concerns from US-Israeli strikes on Iran. Malls, including Dubai Mall, and essential services operate normally; no public holidays today.

Tracks of preparedness

Etihad Rail, coordinating with Abu Dhabi’s ADCMC, operated three exceptional passenger trains from Al Ghuwaifat Station (bordering Saudi Arabia) to Al Faya Station, safely transporting over 350 UAE residents home amid regional travel disruptions. The service, running ahead of the official passenger rail launch, adhered to full safety protocols without affecting freight operations, showcasing the UAE’s emergency transport readiness.

Dubai cools down

Dubai faces partly cloudy to cloudy skies with chances of scattered rainfall and cooler temperatures peaking at 34°C, dipping to 23°C overnight. Light to moderate winds may freshen, causing blowing dust and reduced visibility, with fog alerts in place. Rough seas are expected in the Arabian Gulf, with wave heights reaching up to 7 feet.
 
 
DID YOU KNOW?
 

In the Mirbah area of Fujairah, an Emirati man feeds hundreds daily during Ramadan. Ali Al Kaabi prepares and distributes traditional Harees and other iftar dishes from after Dhuhr until Maghrib, turning a personal act of charity into a powerful symbol of community unity and Emirati heritage.
